name: dotnet-channels
Implements producer/consumer queues using `Channel<T>` with `ChannelWriter<T>`/`ChannelReader<T>` endpoints. Creation/backpressure via bounded/unbounded; integrates with `IAsyncEnumerable` and graceful shutdown. Channel handles synchronization: writers produce items, readers consume.

Bounded: `Channel.CreateBounded<T>(capacity)`; Back-pressure: Yes -- `FullMode` controls behavior when full; Memory safety: Capped at `capacity` items; Use when: Production workloads, untrusted producer rates.
